name: Character Builder
description: Collect role, want, fear, competence, voice, arc, and relationships as stable character fields. Field names are stable for future Canon mapping. This pack does not write canon, characters, locations, or factions. Workflow execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Role
stages.intent: Declare dramatic function: whose story this is and why they are necessary.

stages.title: Motivation
stages.intent: State why that want matters now.

stages.title: Fear
stages.intent: Name the loss they will avoid even at high cost.

stages.title: Strength
stages.intent: Record a competence that can create both rescue and harm.

stages.title: Weakness
stages.intent: Record a pattern that reliably causes error.

stages.title: Backstory
stages.intent: Keep only history that still charges present behavior.

stages.title: Voice
stages.intent: Note diction, silence habits, and forbidden topics.

stages.title: Arc
stages.intent: Sketch start state and pressure toward change without locking an ending.
